```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(duckdb)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

options(knitr.table.format = "html")
project_root <- params$project_root
db_root <- ""
db_path <- params$db_path
if (!is.null(db_path) && nzchar(trimws(db_path))) {
  db_candidate <- tryCatch(normalizePath(db_path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE), error = function(e) "")
  if (nzchar(db_candidate)) {
    db_root <- dirname(dirname(db_candidate))
  }
}
root_candidates <- c(
  if (!is.null(project_root)) project_root else "",
  db_root,
  Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR", unset = ""),
  getwd(),
  file.path(getwd(), ".."),
  file.path(getwd(), "../..")
)
root_candidates <- unique(root_candidates[nzchar(root_candidates)])
root_dir <- NA_character_
for (candidate in root_candidates) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(candidate, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  if (file.exists(file.path(candidate, "R", "logic_reports_veg.R"))) {
    root_dir <- candidate
    break
  }
}
if (is.na(root_dir)) stop("Unable to locate project root for report helpers.")
source(file.path(root_dir, "R", "logic_reports_veg.R"))
parquet_dir <- params$parquet_dir
if (!is.null(parquet_dir) && nzchar(trimws(parquet_dir))) {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = ":memory:")
  tbls <- c("Sample_Env", "Sample_SU")
  for (tbl in tbls) {
    file_name <- paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", tbl), ".parquet")
    file_path <- file.path(parquet_dir, file_name)
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      dbExecute(
        con,
        sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('%s')", tbl, gsub("'", "''", file_path))
      )
    }
  }
} else {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), params$db_path, read_only = TRUE)
}
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
plots <- parse_plot_numbers(params$plot_number, params$plot_numbers)
if (length(plots) == 0 && nzchar(trimws(params$site_unit)) && DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "Sample_SU")) {
  su_df <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
    con,
    "SELECT PlotNumber FROM Sample_SU WHERE SiteUnit = ?",
    list(trimws(params$site_unit))
  )
  plots <- unique(as.character(su_df$PlotNumber))
}
if (length(plots) == 0 && nzchar(trimws(params$project_id)) && DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "Sample_Env")) {
  env_df <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
    con,
    "SELECT PlotNumber FROM Sample_Env WHERE ProjectID = ?",
    list(trimws(params$project_id))
  )
  plots <- unique(as.character(env_df$PlotNumber))
}

plots <- plots[nzchar(plots)]
if (length(plots) > 0) {
  plot_sql <- paste(DBI::dbQuoteString(con, plots), collapse = ", ")
  labels <- dbGetQuery(
    con,
    sprintf(
      "SELECT * FROM Sample_Env WHERE PlotNumber IN (%s) ORDER BY PlotNumber",
      plot_sql
    )
  )
} else if (nzchar(trimws(params$project_id))) {
  labels <- dbGetQuery(
    con,
    "SELECT * FROM Sample_Env WHERE ProjectID = ? ORDER BY PlotNumber",
    list(trimws(params$project_id))
  )
} else {
  labels <- dbGetQuery(
    con,
    "SELECT * FROM Sample_Env ORDER BY PlotNumber"
  )
}

normalize_env_cols <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  cols <- names(df)
  pick_col <- function(candidates) {
    idx <- which(tolower(cols) %in% tolower(candidates))
    if (length(idx) > 0) cols[[idx[1]]] else NA_character_
  }
  plot_col <- pick_col(c("plotnumber", "PlotNumber"))
  proj_col <- pick_col(c("projectid", "ProjectID"))
  zone_col <- pick_col(c("zone", "_zone", "Zone"))
  subzone_col <- pick_col(c("subzone", "SubZone"))
  site_series_col <- pick_col(c("siteseries", "SiteSeries"))
  representing_col <- pick_col(c("plotrepresenting", "PlotRepresenting"))
  if (!is.na(plot_col)) df$plotnumber <- df[[plot_col]]
  if (!is.na(proj_col)) df$projectid <- df[[proj_col]]
  if (!is.na(zone_col)) df$zone <- df[[zone_col]]
  if (!is.na(subzone_col)) df$subzone <- df[[subzone_col]]
  if (!is.na(site_series_col)) df$siteseries <- df[[site_series_col]]
  if (!is.na(representing_col)) df$representing <- df[[representing_col]]
  df
}

labels <- normalize_env_cols(labels)

if (nrow(labels) > 0) {
  desired <- c("plotnumber", "projectid", "zone", "subzone", "siteseries", "representing")
  cols <- intersect(desired, names(labels))
  labels <- labels[, cols, drop = FALSE]
}

null_to_empty <- function(value) {
  if (is.null(value)) return("")
  value <- as.character(value)
  value[is.na(value)] <- ""
  value
}

pad_right <- function(value, width) {
  value <- null_to_empty(value)
  padding <- pmax(width - nchar(value), 0)
  paste0(value, strrep(" ", padding))
}

if (nrow(labels) > 0) {
  labels <- labels %>%
    mutate(
      plotnumber = null_to_empty(plotnumber),
      projectid = null_to_empty(projectid),
      zone = null_to_empty(zone),
      subzone = null_to_empty(subzone),
      siteseries = null_to_empty(siteseries),
      representing = null_to_empty(representing),
      zone_label = paste0(pad_right(zone, 4), subzone, "/", siteseries)
    )
}

dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

# `r params$report_title`

```{r labels-style, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
apply_theme <- isTRUE(params$apply_theme)
label_border <- if (apply_theme) "#666" else "#999"
label_font <- if (apply_theme) "Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" else "Arial, sans-serif"
plot_size <- if (apply_theme) "11px" else "12px"
project_size <- if (apply_theme) "11px" else "12px"
zone_size <- if (apply_theme) "11px" else "12px"
represent_size <- if (apply_theme) "9px" else "10px"
date_size <- if (apply_theme) "8px" else "9px"
min_height <- if (apply_theme) "96px" else "110px"

cat(
  "<style>\n",
  ".bec-label-grid { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-bottom: 14px; table-layout: fixed; }\n",
  ".bec-label-grid td { width: 33%; vertical-align: top; padding: 4px; }\n",
  ".bec-label { border: 1px solid ", label_border, "; padding: 5px 6px; min-height: ", min_height, "; font-family: ", label_font, "; line-height: 1.15; }\n",
  ".bec-label .plot { font-size: ", plot_size, "; font-weight: 700; }\n",
  ".bec-label .project { font-size: ", project_size, "; font-weight: 700; }\n",
  ".bec-label .zone { font-size: ", zone_size, "; font-weight: 700; text-align: right; }\n",
  ".bec-label .representing { font-size: ", represent_size, "; margin-top: 1px; }\n",
  ".bec-label .date { font-size: ", date_size, "; margin-top: 3px; }\n",
  "</style>\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

```{r labels-render, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(labels) == 0) {
  cat("No labels available.")
} else {
  label_date <- format(Sys.Date(), "%B %d, %Y")
  label_rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(labels)), function(i) {
    row <- labels[i, , drop = FALSE]
    list(
      plot = row$plotnumber,
      project = row$projectid,
      zone = row$zone_label,
      representing = row$representing
    )
  })

  chunk_size <- 12
  total_chunks <- ceiling(length(label_rows) / chunk_size)

  for (chunk in seq_len(total_chunks)) {
    start_idx <- (chunk - 1) * chunk_size + 1
    end_idx <- min(chunk * chunk_size, length(label_rows))
    chunk_rows <- label_rows[start_idx:end_idx]

    cells <- vector("list", chunk_size)
    for (i in seq_len(chunk_size)) {
      if (i <= length(chunk_rows)) {
        cell <- chunk_rows[[i]]
        cells[[i]] <- sprintf(
          "<div class=\"bec-label\"><div class=\"plot\">%s</div><div class=\"project\">%s</div><div class=\"zone\">%s</div><div class=\"representing\">%s</div><div class=\"date\">Label Date: %s</div></div>",
          cell$plot,
          cell$project,
          cell$zone,
          cell$representing,
          label_date
        )
      } else {
        cells[[i]] <- "<div class=\"bec-label\"></div>"
      }
    }

    cat("<table class=\"bec-label-grid\">\n")
    row_idx <- 1
    for (r in seq_len(4)) {
      cat("<tr>\n")
      for (c in seq_len(3)) {
        cat("<td>", cells[[row_idx]], "</td>\n")
        row_idx <- row_idx + 1
      }
      cat("</tr>\n")
    }
    cat("</table>\n")
  }
}
```
